title: More than half the state's wind is here
text: The turbines standing on both sides of Tehachapi Pass are a large share of California's wind power. The projects here and out in the Antelope Valley add up to 3,254 megawatts, out of 6,171 megawatts operating in the whole state. In 2024 California's wind farms generated about 7 percent of all the power made inside the state.
